senses.gloss: ch. same, esp. a sacred object held in hand at the delivery of an oath.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 38b:22">Shebu. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>צריך לאתפושי ח׳ בידיה</he> the judge must make him hold an object (Torah) in his hand.

<cite ref="Shevuot 38b:24">Ib.</cite> <he>האי דיינא דאשבע … ולא תפיס ח׳ בידיה</he> Ms. F. Margin (v. Rabb. D. S. a l. note 40) a judge that administers an oath by the Lord …, while the affirmant holds no object &c.
<cite ref="Shevuot 38b:24">Ib.</cite> <he>דהא לא נקיט ח׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="M01098"><he>מידעם</he></cite>) for he had nothing in his hand.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 91a:14">B. Kam. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>למימד ח׳ וכ׳</he> to give an opinion on the fact whether or not he has caused that injury.
